BARRY SAWYER writes from Melbourne, Australia where he spends his week-ends with Percy Cerutty at the famous Portsea training camp. He hopes to be back in Europe in 1972 and issues a warning to Trevor Hart ("how did that 'nong' get three photos in one gazette?"), to get in plenty of training as Barr…
Barry Sawyer won the Victorian "King of the Mountains" 20 mile race in Australia and now has his name inscribed alongside that of past winner Percy Cerutty.
It is fitting that he and that well-known Aussie iron-man Percy Cerutty should continue to see a lot of each other. Barry writes:"Percy is now living with his son Neil just around the corner.
He is still very much under the spell of Portsea and spends much time in the company of that effervescent 75yrs old Percy Cerutty who is now back in residence there.
His aims are the Australian Marathon Championship next October and the 'Comrades' in 1972, after which he will join Percy Cerutty in Jamaica and Munich.
